objective: Create multiple legitimate paths to the first verified profitable PrismBay Clean sale without weakening commercial evidence standards.

strategies.action: Close exact freight, margin and checkout gates on the nearest commercial SKU.
strategies.fallback: Advance the strongest backup product immediately.

strategies.action: Run supplier and economics verification on multiple backup products in parallel.
strategies.fallback: Replace rejected candidates with newly researched low-regulation products.

strategies.action: Prepare search-intent product and problem-solution landing content on owned PrismBay Clean surfaces for verified products.
strategies.fallback: Build evergreen category/problem pages while product verification remains incomplete.

strategies.action: Prepare Merchant Center-compatible product feed, shipping, returns and structured product data for eligible target markets; activate only through an eligible verified merchant account.
strategies.fallback: Use owned-search SEO if Merchant Center eligibility or account verification is unavailable.

strategies.action: Prepare Product Rich Pin metadata and catalog-ready product data; publish only where the business account, claimed site and regional eligibility requirements are satisfied.
strategies.fallback: Use standard organic visual content pointing to owned product pages where permitted.

strategies.action: Prepare open-collaboration and creator-affiliate package for a sale-ready SKU; activate only if the seller account and product are eligible.
strategies.fallback: Maintain owner-approved creator shortlist and rights-safe briefs without bulk outreach.

strategies.action: Prepare truthful listing packages for eligible marketplaces such as eBay, including title, specs, shipping, returns and image requirements; do not publish without account eligibility and approval.
strategies.fallback: Route traffic to owned storefront instead of forcing marketplace publication.

strategies.action: Model single-unit, multi-unit, bundle, threshold-shipping and cross-sell offers using verified landed cost and contribution margin.
strategies.fallback: Keep the base offer unchanged if economics evidence is incomplete or a live price change is not approved.

strategies.action: Continuously audit mobile product page, trust, shipping disclosure, CTA, refund information, speed and checkout friction before traffic scales.
strategies.fallback: Repair the existing storefront and checkout mapping before creating replacement infrastructure.

strategies.action: Prepare original rights-safe problem-solution, demonstration, comparison, FAQ and objection-handling creative for likely-to-clear products.
strategies.fallback: Use product-neutral educational problem/solution concepts until a SKU becomes promotion-ready.

strategies.action: Maintain a qualified creator/affiliate shortlist and commission model for owner-approved outreach after product readiness.
strategies.fallback: Use open-collaboration platform mechanisms where available instead of unsolicited bulk outreach.

strategies.action: Maintain ranked tests for offer, page, creative and channel hypotheses with explicit metrics and stop conditions.
strategies.fallback: Run measurement and preflight tests internally until sufficient external traffic exists.
